data.title: Publish: GitHub repo + Pages deploy + README + GPL-3.0 LICENSE

data.body: Done by orchestrator: LICENSE (verbatim GPL-3.0 from gnu.org, 674 lines) + package.json license field; vite.config.ts with base './' (works for Pages subpath, preview, and Tauri); README (brand-voiced, features, keymap, dev quickstart, desktop/releases section, GPL note); .github/workflows/pages.yml (official upload/deploy-pages actions); repo malls/pattern-maker created public, full history pushed; Pages enabled build_type=workflow. Deploy green; site serves 200 at https://www.forrestalmasi.com/pattern-maker/ (account custom domain — github.io URL redirects there); favicon + JS bundle verified 200 under the subpath. README updated to the real URL.

REVIEW (fresh context, vs plan task_01KZSF0C9NB7N0NJADGFZPP14G): PASS. LICENSE: sha256 3972dc97... == canonical gnu.org gpl-3.0.txt, 674 lines, ends with the full 'How to Apply' section incl. the why-not-lgpl link — verbatim, no truncation. package.json license GPL-3.0-only; vite.config.ts base './' unconditional. README: every checked claim TRUE against source — tool keys p/e/l/r/o/f/i match src/tools/* hotkeys (eyedropper=i, fill=f confirmed), m=select, cmd-C/X/V + Enter stamps + Esc cancels (main.ts keydown), z zoom + arrows + Esc, 1/2 mode keys, [/] palette step, cmd-Z / shift-cmd-Z undo/redo (ctrl+y bonus redo unlisted, fine); six palettes match PaletteId union exactly; cell size MIN_CELL=1/MAX_CELL=64; EXPORT_SCALES [1,2,4]; click-to-fill confirmed in rect/ellipse tools. Links well-formed; repo remote is malls/pattern-maker matching releases link; BRANDING.md + public/favicon.svg exist. Live site: https://www.forrestalmasi.com/pattern-maker/ serves 200; favicon.svg, favicon-32.png, hashed JS + CSS all 200 under the subpath with relative hrefs. pages.yml: actionlint clean; correct pages:write/id-token:write perms, concurrency group, node 22 + npm ci + build + upload dist + deploy. npm run build (tsc+vite) clean. Note: plan said malls.github.io URL; README's custom-domain URL (commit 5f98f7e) is live and correct. No defects found. -> done.
